comparison.objective: Remove a hidden ball obstruction before fully inserting a peg without excessive force.
comparison.physical_skill: Force-sensitive diagnosis, withdrawal, block tipping, obstruction removal, and reinsertion.
comparison.success_condition: Ball is outside the bore, peg is home, and no over-force damage latch or drop occurs.
comparison.reason: This is obstruction diagnosis and safe peg insertion, not intentional setting and locking of an adjustable motion stop.
